ud2.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Anupiyāyaṃ viharati Ambavane.
ud2.10:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kāligodhāya putto araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud2.10:2.1: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū āyasmato Bhaddiyassa Kāligodhāya puttassa araññagatassa pi rukkhamūlagatassa pi suññāgāragatassa pi abhikkhanaṃ udānam udānentassa:
ud2.10:2.4: nissaṃsayaṃ kho āvuso āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kāligodhāya putto anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carati
ud2.10:2.5: yaṃ'sa pubbe agārikabhūtassa rajjasukhaṃ. so tam anussaramāno araññagato pi . . . abhikkhaṇaṃ udānam udānesi:
ud2.10:3.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu , upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud2.10:3.2: āyasmā bhante Bhaddiyo Kāḷigodhāya putto araññagato pi . . . udānesi:
ud2.10:3.4: nissaṃsayaṃ kho Bhaddiyo Kāḷigodhāya putto anabhirato . . . pe . . .
ud2.10:4.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
ud2.10:4.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena Bhaddiyaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
ud2.10:5.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yen' āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kāḷigodhāya putto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Bhaddiyaṃ Kāḷigodhāya puttaṃ etad avoca:
ud2.10:5.3: evaṃ āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kāḷigodhāya putto tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Bhaddiyaṃ Kāḷigodhāya puttaṃ bhagavā etad avoca:
ud2.10:6.1: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Bhaddiya araññagato pi . . .
ud2.10:7.1: kaṃ pana tvaṃ Bhaddiya atthavasaṃ sampassamāno
ud2.10:7.3: pubbe me bhante agārikabhūtassa rajjasukhaṃ karontassa anto pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi bahi pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi. anto pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi bahi pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi. anto pi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi bahi pi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi.
ud2.10:7.4: so kho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ rakkhito gopito santo bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrasto vihāsiṃ
ud2.10:7.5: etarahi kho pan' āhaṃ bhante araññagato pi rukkhamūlagato pi suññāgāragato pi ekako abhīto anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrasto appossukko pannalomo paradavutto migabhūtena cetasā viharāmi.
ud2.10:7.6: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagato . . . pe . . . udānesiṃ: . . .
ud2.10:8.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
